title: Read-Only Schedule Action
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a list of schedule symbols, and let $B$ be a base configuration for the schedule controller. For optional phases $q,q'$ and integers $u,g$, applying the schedule action that enters phase $q'$, leaves the input head, budget head, and clock work tapes fixed, moves the unary-counter and guide heads by signs $d_u,d_g$, and emits nothing, to the macrostep configuration determined by $B,q,u,g$ gives the macrostep configuration determined by $B,q',u+d_u,g+d_g$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$x$ is a list of schedule symbols
replaced:
Let a macrostep configuration with phase $q$, unary head $u$, and guide head $g$ be
given.  Applying the read-only schedule action that enters a phase $q'$, keeps the
input and budget heads fixed, writes nothing, and moves the unary and guide heads in
directions $d_u$ and $d_g$ yields the macrostep configuration with phase $q'$, unary
head $u + d_u$, and guide head $g + d_g$.
